fusions.name: Coop Wire Toss
fusions.desc: Hurls a snarl of twine that deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hemmed In
fusions.desc: Cinches a mesh of cord around every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 22 damage that ignores resistances. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rally the Pen
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 6 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Twine-Tied Chick
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded chick familiar that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage. Anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
